entities.summary: Antonio Alfonseca is a Dominican former professional baseball relief pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Florida Marlins, Chicago Cubs (2002–2003), Atlanta Braves (2004), Texas Rangers (2006), and Philadelphia Phillies (2007).
